delivered.statement: Achieved profitability in quick commerce this quarter; maintaining pricing discipline

80-90% coverage in pin codes across top 8 metros achieved
17 million sq ft warehousing capacity across dark stores and supply chain hubs
Extremely low CAC in quick commerce due to competitors' reduced marketing spend

themes: Quality/sustainable growth prioritized; must drive profitability over pure GMV expansion
Pricing discipline maintained despite industry-wide discounting and competitive intensity
Competitive intensity equally high in metros and tier-2/3 cities
Assortment expansion key lever alongside store footprint for growth
Reinvesting incremental margins into growth where ROI demonstrable
